gemini-2.5-flash.exact_reserve_text: The claims development table on page 14 indicates a gross release of $24.5m for underwriting years 2013-2021. The claims ratio of syndicate 6107 has improved to 34% in 2023 (2022: 53%) mostly due to a relatively quiet weather related natural catastrophe season during the year. During the period, the managing agent refined its methodology for estimating claims reserves, including revising the actuarial methodology behind determining the risk margin to determine the appropriate level of margin in reserves. These changes have been accounted for prospectively as a change in estimate. As a result of these changes the reserves were strengthened by $4.1m in the period (on a net of reinsurance basis).

gpt-5-mini.data_quality_notes: Prior year development derived from the gross claims development triangle (gross), summing movements for underwriting years up to 2021. Some development-cell alignments in the printed table are unusual (large movements in older years and decreases in some middle years) and a change in reserving methodology (net strengthening $4.1m) may distort direct comparisons. The regulatory segmental premium split in the report is given as percentages of earned premiums rather than explicit amounts; hence class amounts are not provided and percentages were used where available.
